sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/MOVENPICK HOTEL/Movenpick hotel  - SUNWORLD SAFARIS-FIT 2026.pdf
documentType: Leisure Distribution Agreement (full legal contract), Schedule 2 (Applicable FIT Rates) on page 13/15

validity.raw: STATIC RATES valid from 01 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026

roomCategories.unit: per room per night, Bed & Breakfast (inclusive of buffet breakfast, internet and taxes; non-commissionable)

familyRoom.note: King size bed plus twin beds; no single figure given

childPolicy.raw: 0 - below 12 years can stay free with parents on existing bed arrangement. Child in own room is at 75%. F&B charged at 50%.

notes: Contracted meals available at the All-Day Dining Baluba Restaurant.
Standard check-in 14:00 / check-out 12:00. Early check-in (07:00-10:00) and late check-out (13:00-18:00) charged at 50% of room rate.
Hotel reserves right to issue stop-sale with 24 hours' notice.

This document is a full bilateral Leisure Distribution Agreement (Sunworld Safaris as 'Client'/agent, not the traveling guest) - most of its 15 pages are boilerplate legal terms (definitions, indemnification, force majeure, confidentiality, etc.) with no additional pricing beyond Schedule 2.

policies.cancellation: Bookings released 48 hours prior to arrival at no charge. Cancellation after 48-hour window: charged for one night stay inclusive of taxes.
policies.payment: Client (Sunworld) prepays prior to guest stay, immediately upon booking.
policies.fakeOrTentativeNames: Bookings under fake/tentative names are invalid and will be cancelled.
